title: Prisma Performance Optimization
description: Optimize Prisma queries with indexes, select/include, and EXPLAIN for production performance.

data.text: Performance optimization in Prisma involves selecting the right queries, adding database indexes, and analyzing query plans. Small changes can have a large impact on response times.

data.title: Index Definition
data.content: Add an index to the email field.

items: Use `select` to fetch only the fields you need
Use `include` instead of multiple queries for relations
Add indexes on frequently filtered or sorted columns
Use cursor pagination for large datasets
Avoid N+1 queries by using `include` or relation filters

data.title: Tip
data.text: Always run `EXPLAIN ANALYZE` on slow queries. Prisma's query logging makes it easy to copy and analyze queries in a PostgreSQL client.
